## Type of change

- [ ] Feature
- [ ] Bug fix

## Verification

- [ ] `dart format --output=none --set-exit-if-changed lib test`
- [ ] `flutter analyze`
- [ ] `flutter test`
- [ ] `flutter build apk --release` when application code/dependencies/Android configuration changed

## Product checks

- [ ] No private Moodle calendar URL, token, credential, key, or secret is included
- [ ] Arabic/English and RTL behavior were considered when UI changed
- [ ] Parser/notification edge cases have tests when applicable
- [ ] Documentation or `CHANGELOG.md` was updated when needed

## Screenshots / notes

Add screenshots for visible UI changes or any reviewer notes here.
